title: Team Phoenix Bootcamp
teaser: Two days to go before the championship final. Team Phoenix was living in a rented cottage and training eight hours a day. In the evening coach Gaidarov said that in the morning he'd announce who he was dropping from the roster. At 04:20 he was found dead in the gaming room: he was sitting in his headphones with his head slumped on the keyboard, and a match was still playing on the monitor.

habits.label: Red eyes
habits.habit: Eyes red from lack of sleep
clues: An empty bottle of eye drops lies on the desk in the gaming room, though Gaidarov never used them. The culprit has red eyes.
There are splashes on the mirror in the hallway, and the cap from a bottle of eye drops lies under it. The culprit has red eyes.

habits.label: Wristband
habits.habit: A sweatband on their right wrist
clues: Gaidarov's mouse has towelling fluff on it, like from a wristband. The culprit wears a wristband.
A black wristband hangs on the barbell in the basement gym, and nobody has claimed it. The culprit wears a wristband.

habits.label: Fingerless gloves
clues: Gaidarov's neck shows prints of bare fingers but no palm marks, as if the palm was gloved. The culprit wears fingerless gloves.
A thread from a knitted glove with cut-off fingers is caught on the balcony railing. The culprit wears fingerless gloves.

habits.label: Instant noodles
clues: Next to Gaidarov's keyboard stands a still-warm noodle cup, though he never ate that stuff. The culprit eats instant noodles.
There's a mountain of empty noodle cups under one of the beds in the players' bedroom. The culprit eats instant noodles.

habits.label: Jersey with a nickname
habits.habit: Wears their team jersey with their nickname on the back
clues: The balcony camera caught someone from behind in a team jersey, but a shadow hid the nickname. The culprit wears a jersey with a nickname.
A thread from a nickname patch lies behind Gaidarov's chair. The culprit wears a jersey with a nickname.

habits.label: Blue fringe
clues: There's a blue hair on the back of Gaidarov's chair, and the coach was grey. The culprit has a blue fringe.
The sink in the bathroom by the hallway has blue streaks of hair dye. The culprit has a blue fringe.

habits.label: Toe socks
clues: The varnished floor of the gaming room shows a footprint with separate toes, like from a toe sock. The culprit wears toe socks.
The mat in the basement gym has the print of a sock with separate toes. The culprit wears toe socks.

habits.label: Neck gaiter
clues: Gaidarov's neck has a thin mark from fabric, like a tightened neck gaiter. The culprit wears a neck gaiter.
The snow on the balcony has the print of patterned fabric, like a neck gaiter. The culprit wears a neck gaiter.

habits.label: Crab crisps
habits.habit: Fingers covered in crab-flavoured crisp crumbs
clues: Gaidarov's keyboard has orange crumbs on it and smells of crab-flavoured crisps. The culprit has crisp crumbs on their fingers.
The kitchen door handle has a greasy orange smear. The culprit has crisp crumbs on their fingers.

habits.label: Fidget spinner
clues: At 04:15 Gaidarov's microphone picked up a quiet whirr behind him, like a spinner. The culprit twirls a fidget spinner.
A bearing from a spinner lies under the desk in the analyst's room. The culprit twirls a fidget spinner.

habits.label: Headband
clues: The headrest of the chair in the gaming room has a damp patch, like from a sweaty headband. The culprit wears a headband.
A towelling headband lies in a snowdrift on the balcony. The culprit wears a headband.

habits.label: Nose ring
habits.habit: A small ring in their nose
clues: A tiny nose ring lies under Gaidarov's desk. The culprit has a nose ring.
In the stream recording a face was reflected on a dark screen, and something glinted at the nostril. The culprit has a nose ring.

habits.label: Blue-light glasses
clues: A chip of yellow lens from computer glasses lies on Gaidarov's keyboard. The culprit wears blue-light glasses.
An empty case for computer glasses lies on the desk in the analyst's room. The culprit wears blue-light glasses.

habits.label: Protein shaker
clues: White powder is spilled on the desk in the gaming room. It isn't poison, it's vanilla protein. The culprit carries a protein shaker.
There's a fresh puddle of protein shake on the floor of the basement gym. The culprit carries a protein shaker.

habits.label: Swears in English
clues: In the voice chat recording at 04:17 someone swore in English through gritted teeth. The culprit swears in English.
The cottage owner heard a short English curse from the balcony, then a door slam. The culprit swears in English.

habits.label: Fang pendant
habits.habit: A fang-shaped pendant round the neck
clues: A plastic fang on a snapped cord lies under Gaidarov's hand. The culprit wears a fang pendant.
A scrap of cord just like the one on the fang pendant lies on the hallway mat. The culprit wears a fang pendant.

sched: Every night from four to five Gaidarov went through match recordings alone while the others slept. The culprit knows the schedule.
The stream operator ends the practice broadcast at 04:00, and after that nobody goes into the gaming room. The culprit knows the schedule.
safe: The safe with the players' contracts in the analyst's room was opened with the code, and one contract is missing. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The team's account on the tournament site was opened with the password, and one player in the final roster was swapped. The culprit knows the safe combination.
quiet: Every floorboard in the gaming room creaks, yet Gaidarov in his headphones never turned round. The culprit moves silently.
Everyone in the players' bedroom sleeps lightly, but nobody heard anyone get up. The culprit moves silently.
passages: An old staircase through the boiler room leads from the basement gym to the gaming room. Only the owner and the cleaner know about it. The culprit knows the service passages.
A fire ladder runs from the balcony to the garage roof, and there are fresh footprints in the snow on its rungs. The culprit knows the service passages.
tech: A match replay was running on Gaidarov's monitor, and at 04:12 his computer was cut off from the network through the router. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The last half hour of voice chat was wiped from the team server, and everything else is still there. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
cash: At 04:25 the semi-final prize money was transferred from the team account to an unknown card. The culprit had access to money.
The box in the kitchen with the grocery money is empty, though in the evening it held enough for a week. The culprit had access to money.
driver: The manager's car was moved from the gate to the garage, leaving fresh ruts in the snow. The culprit can drive.
The courier's car isn't where he left it, and the engine is still warm. The culprit can drive.
medic: The water bottle on Gaidarov's desk holds a strong sleeping drug, the dose matched to his weight. The culprit knows about poisons.
A pack of sedatives went missing from the psychologist's first-aid kit, and an empty box from another drug was put in its place. The culprit knows about poisons.
french: A sticker on Gaidarov's monitor says "Fin du jeu", French for "Game over". The culprit knows French.
At 04:22 a message came into the team chat from someone else's account: "Il ne jouera plus", meaning "He won't play again". The culprit knows French.
keys: The analyst's room was locked with a key, and the laptop with the tactics is gone from it. The culprit had keys.
The back garden gate was unlocked with a key and locked again, and the only key hangs on the owner's bunch. The culprit had keys.
strong: Gaidarov, a big man, was held by the shoulders so hard that it left bruises. The culprit is physically strong.
The server cabinet in the analyst's room, which weighs over a hundred kilos, was pulled away from the wall. The culprit is physically strong.
tools: The case of Gaidarov's computer was opened with a screwdriver and one drive taken out, then the screws were put back in. The culprit is handy with tools.
The camera cable in the gaming room was cut at the connector and wrapped in electrical tape so it wouldn't catch the eye. The culprit is handy with tools.
